name: 10029 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10029 (New York) has 245 nonprofit organizations. 102 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 80 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10029 (New York) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list public events
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 17 would.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.text: 22 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10029 (New York) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
